svg.title: Weights mix coordinates rather than certify facts
svg.desc: A hand-calculated query [1,0], identity keys and value rows [2,0] and [0,4] produce weights about 0.670 and 0.330. Multiplying each value row by its weight and adding gives output [1.340,1.321]. These synthetic coordinates are neither token probabilities nor truth scores.
